known_limitations: Metadata sanitization cannot guarantee that a file will not be classified as AI-generated.
SynthID and other signal-level or steganographic watermarks are outside the metadata sanitizer and are not claimed removed.
C2PA is general provenance, not AI-specific; removing it can destroy legitimate authenticity credentials.
Native post-condition verification shares parser logic with mutation; independent backends reduce but cannot eliminate common-mode blind spots.
The engine applies a finite file-size budget but still reads budget-compliant native files into memory rather than streaming them.
OOXML hidden content is inventoried but not destructively removed in 0.3.0.
ISO-BMFF/HEIC/HEIF/MP4/MOV/M4A, PDF, TIFF/DNG and several other C2PA-capable formats are not native sanitization targets yet.
Animated or multi-frame raster rebuilds fail closed.
Cross-platform runtime validation was not performed locally; CI is configured for Python 3.11, 3.12 and 3.13 on Ubuntu.
